title: opmledit settings
description: data/config.json: settings the admin can change. Every key is optional; a missing key means its default. See config.md.

podcastindex_max_results.description: Most feeds one search returns (PodcastIndex gives at most 1000).

cache_seconds.description: Seconds PodcastIndex answers are reused from data/cache, per kind.

search.description: Seconds a search answer is reused (every search mode, each tag page). 0: not cached.

feeds.description: Seconds a single feed lookup by guid, URL or id is reused, including "not found"; also used by Check all feeds. 0: not cached.

episodes.description: Seconds a feed's fetched episodes are reused before the feed is asked again (with ETag / Last-Modified, so an unchanged feed is not downloaded). 0: not cached.

categories.description: Seconds the PodcastIndex category list is reused. 0: not cached.

max_upload_bytes.description: Largest OPML file in bytes accepted for import, uploaded or downloaded from a URL.

fetch_timeout.description: Seconds fetching a URL may take in total (import from URL, a feed's episodes).

max_url_imports_per_hour.description: Imports from URL per signed-in user per hour.

max_feed_bytes.description: Largest feed in bytes downloaded for its episodes.

max_episodes.description: Most episodes read from one feed, the first ones in feed order (usually the newest).

max_requests_per_hour.description: API requests per IP address per hour without a session (search, lookup, episodes, …).

max_document_bytes.description: Largest document in bytes, as saved and as stored.

max_nodes.description: Most outline elements in a document.

max_depth.description: Deepest nesting of outline elements, in levels.

max_documents_per_user.description: Most documents in one user's library.

retention_days.description: Days a library document is kept after it was last opened, saved or exported.
